claims: Pet sitting provides in-home care, feeding, and companionship for pets.
Pet sitting drop-ins or overnights typically cost $30–$45 per day.
Drop-in visits focus on potty breaks.
Overnight stays involve a sitter staying at the pet owner's home.
Overnight stays often cost around $45–$250+ per day depending on experience and location.
Qualified sitters offer services like walking.
Qualified sitters usually require pet care experience.
Qualified sitters usually require love for animals.
Many platforms like Rover and PetSitter.com provide background-checked sitters.
